name: visimark
title_zh: 报价单里每个数字都验算一遍的Markdown校对员
tagline_zh: 报价、预算、工程计算混在Markdown里，肉眼核对总怕漏。它把每个算式当代码跑一遍，错一处就标红给你看。
tagline_en: Quotes, budgets, engineering calcs buried in Markdown—it executes each formula and flags mismatches, even.
desc_en: Use when authoring, editing, or verifying a Markdown document containing arithmetic — a quote, invoice, budget, estimate, payment schedule, or engineering calculation — or when working in a repository that contains `vmark` blocks or a `visimark` dependency.
why_zh: 不靠正则猜数字，而是真正解析Markdown里的算术表达式并执行，结果与文档并排呈现，错位即错。
why_en: Parses and runs arithmetic expressions in Markdown, not regex guesswork; side-by-side results make any drift instantly visible.
limit_zh: 只认Markdown文档里的算术表达式，不检查文字逻辑或单位换算；需文档本身含可解析算式，纯叙述性数字不触发。
limit_en: Only checks arithmetic expressions in Markdown; ignores prose numbers and unit logic. Needs parseable formulas to act.
title_en: Markdown proofreader that recalculates every number in.
